account_id.description: The asset account it sits on: one whose report group is Property, plant & equipment or Intangible assets.

accumulated_depreciation.description: Its accumulated depreciation at the books start, in the base currency, as the opening balances carry it on 1590.

cost.description: What it cost, in the base currency, as the opening balances carry it on its account.

purchased_on.description: The day it was bought: before the books start.
